name: Upsert Pharmacy
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Upserts a pharmacy record in the Pharmacies object using the provided NPI as the lookup key. Links the resulting pharmacy record to the given pharmacy reference record.

inputs.name: matched_npi
inputs.label: Matched NPI
inputs.description: NPI of the pharmacy to upsert

inputs.name: matched_street
inputs.label: Matched Street
inputs.description: Street address of the matched pharmacy

inputs.name: matched_zip
inputs.label: Matched Zip
inputs.description: Zip code of the matched pharmacy

inputs.name: search_type
inputs.label: Search Type
inputs.description: 'digital' to set type to Mail, otherwise defaults to Retail

inputs.name: ref_name
inputs.label: Reference Name
inputs.description: Name of the pharmacy reference record to link to the upserted pharmacy

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the call summary record to link to the upserted pharmacy

outputs.name: pharmacy_id
outputs.label: Pharmacy ID
outputs.description: Kizen record ID of the created or updated pharmacy record
